title: Exception context suppressed: 1 `raise` statements without `from` (L152)
detail: Raising a new exception inside an `except` block without `raise NewExc() from exc` discards the original traceback, making debugging harder. Suggested fix: use `raise NewExc() from exc` or `raise NewExc() from None` if suppression is intentional.

title: Unpacked output variable(s) silently discarded: err at L92,111,131
detail: Function returns a tuple; one or more unpacked variables are never read. If the discarded variable carries error information (e.g. stderr from a subprocess call), silent discard means errors go unlogged. Suggested fix: check or log the discarded value, or use `_` if intentional.

title: Privsep call stderr discarded silently at L92,111,131
detail: Multiple privsep calls unpack `out, err = privsep.fs.*()` but `err` is never read. If the privsep call emits stderr (e.g. on partial failure), the error is silently dropped. Suggested fix: log `err` when non-empty, or restructure callee to raise on error so the tuple is unnecessary.
